sentence: No acute intracranial hemorrhage, mass effect, or new infarct. Mild chronic ischemic white matter changes are unchanged from prior study.

No significant parenchymal abnormality. Paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells are clear.

No urgent finding requiring change in treatment at this time.
